purpose_text.para: Records the faulting physical address for a synchronous External abort, or SError exception taken to EL1.

field_description.para: Together with PFAR_EL1.NSE, reports the physical address space of the access that triggered the exception.

row.entry: When Secure state is implemented, Secure. Otherwise reserved.

field_description.para: Non-secure. Reports the physical address space of the access that triggered the exception.

field.fields_condition: When EL3 is implemented or FEAT_Secure is implemented

field_description.para: Together with PFAR_EL1.NS, reports the physical address space of the access that triggered the exception.
For a description of the values derived by evaluating NS and NSE together, see MFAR_EL3.NS.
When FEAT_D128 is implemented, extension to PFAR_EL1.PA[47:0].
When FEAT_LPA is implemented, extension to PFAR_EL1.PA[47:0].
Physical Address. Bits [47:0] of the aborting physical address.
For implementations with fewer than 48 physical address bits, the corresponding upper bits in this field are RES0.

The recorded address can be any address within the same naturally-aligned fault granule as the faulting physical address, where the size of the fault granule is IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED and no larger than the larger than:

listitem.content: The size of the range of values permitted to be recorded in FAR_EL1.

access_permission_text.para: When the Effective value of HCR_EL2.E2H is 1, without explicit synchronization, accesses from EL3 using the accessor name PFAR_EL1 or PFAR_EL12 are not guaranteed to be ordered with respect to accesses using the other accessor name.
PFAR_EL1 is not valid and reads UNKNOWN if ESR_EL1.PFV is recorded as 0.
